reply.shortGloss: to win; to gain; to extract
reply.emotion: excited and triumphant, celebrating a victory
notes: Gewinnen is an irregular verb: gewinnen, gewann, gewonnen.
Do not confuse gewinnen (to win) with verdienen (to earn or to deserve).

senses.definition: To be the most successful in a competition, game, or election.

examples.text: Unsere Mannschaft will das Spiel gewinnen.
examples.translation: Our team wants to win the game.
examples.emotion: hopeful and eager, cheering for the team

senses.definition: To obtain or acquire something positive, such as an advantage, time, or trust.

examples.text: Mit dieser Methode kann man viel Zeit gewinnen.
examples.translation: With this method, you can gain a lot of time.
examples.emotion: relieved and practical, sharing a clever shortcut

senses.definition: To extract a substance from a raw material or nature.

examples.text: Aus dieser Pflanze wird Öl gewonnen.
examples.translation: Oil is extracted from this plant.
examples.emotion: informative and matter-of-fact, explaining a process

definitions: To be the most successful in a competition, game, or election.
To obtain or acquire something positive, such as an advantage, time, or trust.
To extract a substance from a raw material or nature.
